Health and stamina regeneration are higher. }} '''Rested''' is a [[status effect]] applied after having the [[Resting]] effect for 20 seconds. The effect is removed when the player character logs out and does not persist into new game sessions. The duration of the effect depends on the [[Comfort]] level from the player's surroundings. Placing furniture and building a shelter will increase the comfort level around the player. The base duration for the Rested effect is 7 minutes, with each comfort level adding an additional minute to the total:
RestedDuration = BaseDuration + ComfortLevel Although not mentioned in its description, the effect also provides a 50% boost to all skill [[experience]] earned. The comfort level does not affect this experience multiplier. ==Tips== * Placing a [[Campfire]] in the entrance hall of [[Points of Interest (POI)#Dungeons|Dungeons]] can quickly restore a 10-minute Rested buff for merely 5 [[Stone]] and 2 [[Wood]]. * While acting as a "buff" to player stats, the opposite should be considered: the lack of having the Rested effect provides a huge disadvantage in combat and traversal and should not be overlooked. ** This especially applies when combined with the [[Wet]] effect, which can make the player extremely vulnerable, such as in the [[Swamp]] (where it is persistent). {{EffectsNav}} [[Category:Effects]] [[ru:Бодрость]]

[[File:Comfy room.png|thumb|256x256px]] '''Comfort''' level determines the duration of [[Resting Effect]]. Minimum duration is 8 minutes (at 1 comfort), with each additional comfort level stacking 1 minute up to 29 minutes with usual items and 31 minutes with both rare seasonal items. The max comfort normally achievable is 22. If also near a [[Maypole]] or the [[Yule Tree]] 23, and if both then 24. When entering most dungeons (such as [[Burial Chambers]]), a campfire can be constructed to easily gain 3 comfort and a 10-minute [[Rested]] effect. Note that while the player can add more than one furniture item from the categories below, only the one with the highest comfort will influence the comfort rating. == List of comfort sources == Only the highest level item of a category will be used. Items in the same category will not stack with other items in the same category. Items with ''no category'' will stack with different items with ''no category''. Health and stamina regeneration is significantly higher. }} '''Resting''' is a [[status effect]] applied when there are no hostile [[creatures]] nearby and the player is sitting near a fire, or while under the [[Fire (effect)|Fire]] effect and [[Shelter]] effect simultaneously. The resting effect cannot be applied if the player is [[Wet]] (unless sitting in a [[Hot Tub]]) or while under the effect of any harming status effect, such as [[Burning]], [[Freezing]] or [[Poison]]. After 20 uninterrupted seconds with the resting effect, the player will receive the [[Rested]] effect. The [[comfort]] level of the surroundings will determine the length of the rested bonus provided, with the rested length being 7 minutes greater than the comfort level (e.g comfort 3 provides 10 minutes of the rested bonus). The resting effect may be reset if a hostile creature approaches, the fire goes out, or in large buildings where the fire radius may not reach all corners of the building. {{EffectsNav}} [[Category:Effects]] [[ru:Отдых]]

The '''Hot tub''' is a decorative item that can be placed on any flooring, and can be built using the [[Hammer]] within the range of a [[Workbench]]. It requires [[Wood]] as fuel and produces smoke while lit. The Hot Tub also increases the [[Comfort]] level by 2 when fueled.

Uniquely, the hot tub will allow a player to gain the [[Rested Effect]] while wet, something that is not normally possible.

Destroying the hot tub with a hammer will not yield back any wood used for fuel and will only return the materials used for its construction. All wood used as fuel will '''not''' be dropped.

While working, it provides the [[Fire Effect]] but only for about one meter around it.

== Notes ==
* A fueled hot tub will eventually kill the player in the Ashlands after spending too much time inside. This occurs in the same way as all water found in the Ashlands biome. In other biomes, the player character can remain in a hot tub indefinitely without being damaged by the water.
